messages.author: d7a934c791b29498
messages.subject: RHDFS with rJava and R 2.15
parts:
rhdfs has a dependency on rJava
rJava is listed as:
Version: 0.9-4
Depends: R (≥ 2.5.0), methods
at URL:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rJava/index.html

However, the latest version of Revolution Analytics, Revo-6.2,
uses R-2.15.3

Does this mean that version 0.9-4 of rJava will not work with 
Revo-6.2?  If so, is there a known version of rJava that will work?
Thanks
